# Automated Technical File — Mistral AI Integration

This cookbook demonstrates how to use Mistral AI models to generate and maintain an **Automated Technical File** (ATF) — a structured, machine-readable compliance artifact produced automatically from source documents.

## Overview

The Automated Technical File pipeline ingests raw technical documents (PDFs, Markdown, structured data) and uses Mistral's language models to extract, classify, and compile a standardised output suitable for regulatory and audit purposes.

## Requirements

See [`requirements.txt`](requirements.txt) for the full dependency list.

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
```
